name: decompile-bench-raw-address
description: A benchmark for evaluating models that recover high-level program information from raw binary addresses and related low-level representations. It measures a model's ability to map addresses/low-level code snippets back to meaningful symbols, references, or decompiled constructs in context. The dataset targets realistic binary-analysis tasks used in reverse engineering and decompilation research.
reputation: Niche but useful within the binary-analysis and program-decompilation community, primarily used by researchers working on LLMs for binaries.
